name: Postel
tagline: Turn viral posts in your niche into your own, then schedule them
description:
Postel's hosted MCP server finds posts that are going viral in your niche, writes your version in your own voice, and schedules or publishes it to X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Bluesky and Mastodon after you approve.

- `search-viral-tweets` works without an account
- 17 tools: drafts, threads, media from URLs, LinkedIn first comments, up to 25 posts per call, scheduling and publishing
- Posts go through each network's official API; it doesn't read feeds or messages, and it doesn't like, reply or follow

Sign-in is OAuth 2.1 on first use, or an API key from Postel (Settings > API Keys) sent as `Authorization: Bearer pstl_...`. Scheduling and publishing need a paid Postel plan or trial.

install.notes: Cline opens Postel's sign-in page the first time a tool needs your account. Connect your networks in Postel under Settings > Channels before your first post.
